title: Koun Sughra ka uthayega janaza bhayya
body:
Koun Sughra ka uthayega janaza bhaiyya, Ghutke marjaye jo furqat mein mariza bhaiyya.
Meri baba se sifarish nahi karta koi, Shahe wala se guzarish nahi karta koi, Sabko lejate hain juz Fatima Sughra bhaiyya.
Apni bemaar behen ko na rulao Akber, Haal baba ko mera jake batao Akber, Apki baat nahi taalte Moula bhaiyya.
Koun masoom Sakina ne yeh farmaya hai, Nannhe Asgher ka bhi ferist mein naam aaya hai, Bas nahi hai to faqat naam hamara bhaiyya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sir jhukaye hue chup chap khade ho Akber, Aur udhar laqte safar baandh chuke hain Sarwar, Ab toh baba se kaho jake Khudara bhaiyya.
Haye ab girya-o-nala na karongi lekin, Aur tumse koi shikwa na karongi lekin, Mere jeene ki duaein nahi karna bhaiyya.
Karbala ka hai irada yehi sab kehte hain, Woh zameen thik nahi ahle Arab kehte hain, Dar hai ghirjaye musibat mein na baba bhaiyya.
Shahe wala ki chaheeti hoon dulari hoon mein, Yeh alag baat ki taqdeer ki mari hoon mein, Mere baba ko masayeb se bachana bhaiyya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab bhi ghurbat se Sakina ko watan yaad aaye, Meri behna ko jo bimaar behen yaad aaye, Tab bada royenge tum dena dilasa bhaiyya.
Ali Akber meri furqat tumhein tadpayegi, Tum jo ro-oge tabhi yaad meri ghabrayegi, Yaad karke mujhe rona na rulana bhaiyya.
Manzile saaj mein chehre pe udasi na rahe, Meri masoom Sakina kahin pyasi na rahe, Mere hisse ka bhi tum pyaar nibhana bhaiyya.
Jald baba ki dua dulha banayegi tumhe, Ek bemaar behen yaad toh ayegi tumhe, Sabr karna meri qatir na tadapna bhaiyya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khudko gar dashte qaza toh na bacha payi mein, Aur shadi mein tumhari toh na aa payi mein, Tum mera nek meri qabr pe lana bhaiyya.
Waqte matam hai 'Hasan' aur qalb mashk baqa, Alweda kehti hai bhai ko behen wawela, Lab pe naara hai mujhe bhul na jana bhaiyya...
